scripts.build: npm run check:openapi && npm run generate:types && tsc -b && vite build && npm run check:bundle
scripts.generate:types: uv run --project .. python scripts/export_openapi.py node_modules/.tmp/openapi.json && openapi-typescript node_modules/.tmp/openapi.json -o src/api/schema.ts
scripts.check:types: npm run check:openapi && npm run generate:types && tsc -b --pretty false
scripts.check: npm run check:types && npm run test && npm run build
